title: A subquadratic zeroing-out subrank upper bound for matrix multiplication

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard tensor products, matrix-multiplication tensor, known independent-set constructions and triangle-removal theorem
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact imported statements and full original bibliography retained; all local promise/coloring/block constructions and invariant arguments included.

core_obligations: Encode an independent tensor support as a tripartite graph.
Control its triangle structure and apply the stated triangle-removal bound.
difficulty_reason: Converts independent supports of the matrix multiplication tensor to a graph with constrained edge-disjoint triangles, then applies the triangle-removal framework to obtain the zero-out subrank bound. The subrank notion is preserved and not silently replaced by general tensor subrank.

dedup.scope: Root checked complete legacy, aliases, preparation and both active lines for exclusive DOI without neighbors. Three principal directions counted: Laser-method upper-bound protocols, zero-out subrank upper bounds, and asymptotic-spectrum communication lower bounds. Tensor-identification framework, random-instance counting bounds and direct group/slice-rank consequences are uncounted support.
